name: Counterstrike
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 12th level; Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Combat Reflexes; haste; Price +3 bonus.

DESCRIPTION

The counterstrike ability may be bestowed on any light weapons. Once per round, when an opponent in melee with the wielder of a counterstrike weapon attacks and misses, the wielder may immediately launch an attack of opportunity against him even if he’s already attacked in the round or even if he is flat-footed.
